subject: Commitment lane: security acceptance & retention action items
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Maria Kowalski <maria.kowalski@harbortrust.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T09:12:00Z
Subject: Commitment lane: security acceptance & retention action items

Hi Maria —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Attaching an updated mutual action plan (MAP_v2.xlsx) and a short SOC 2 ask grid (SOC2-ask-grid.pdf) that maps out what HarborTrust needs to sign off on for a Hosted EU deployment vs a Private (on-prem/VPC) option. High level asks and suggested dates are inline below.

Key acceptance items we propose for the MAP (please confirm):
- SOC 2: Redwood to provide latest Type II report + CAIQ responses. Target delivery: 11/12 (SOC2) and CAIQ by 11/16.
- DPA: draft redline uploaded (DPA_redline_v1.docx) — please review; we'll push via DocuSign for signature after legal alignment.
- Data residency & retention: proposed default tiers — logs 90 days, backups 1 year, transactional records configurable (Hosted default 5 yrs, Private up to 7 yrs). If you need Hosted + 7-year retention we should discuss commercial impact.
- KMS/key custody: options documented (customer-managed KMS for Dedicated/Private; AWS KMS with CMK for Hosted Dedicated).

Next steps I'd like to confirm this week:
1) Maria to confirm whether HarbourTrust intends Hosted EU or Private deployment (deadline: 11/03).
2) HarborTrust to share SIG/CAIQ POC for questionnaire handoff.
3) We will post DPA redline link (DocuSign) by 11/02 and ask legal to target 11/09 for redline call.

If the above looks right I can have Rishi jump in on the technical details (KMS, encryption at rest, key rotation cadence) and Kimberly will lead the DPA redline discussion.

Regards,
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0128

Attachments: MAP_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet), SOC2-ask-grid.pdf (summary)

From: Maria Kowalski <maria.kowalski@harbortrust.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: HarborTrust Security Team <security@harbortrust.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T14:05:34Z
Subject: Re: Commitment lane: security acceptance & retention action items

Jordan —

Thanks for the MAP and the clear breakdown. A few clarifications from the HarborTrust security side before we lock milestone dates:

1) Residency & retention: HarborTrust requires EU residency for customer data. Our standard retention windows are: transactional data 7 years, backups 7 years (unless otherwise negotiated), logs 90 days. Can Redwood commit to 7-year transactional retention on Hosted? If not, we need to consider Private.

2) SOC 2 / CAIQ: We accept a current SOC 2 Type II report but will require the full CAIQ completed for our vendor intake. Can you confirm the CAIQ turnaround? We can provide our intake spreadsheet (attached) to speed things up.

3) DPA redlines: we'll review your DPA_redline_v1.docx. We prefer to exchange edits via DocuSign if possible and aim to conclude legal terms by 11/12.

4) KMS / key separation: important for HarborTrust — we need to understand if customer-managed KEKs are possible on Hosted; if not, which deployment model provides exclusive key custody.

Propose a technical sync (30–45 min) on 11/04 to run through KMS and retention tradeoffs. If Redwood can confirm CAIQ delivery within 5 business days after we hand off the spreadsheet, we can keep the DPA/legal timeline tight.

I'll wait for Rishi/Kimberly to jump in on the KMS and DPA details.

Best,
Maria Kowalski
Head of Information Security | HarborTrust
maria.kowalski@harbortrust.com

Attachment: HarborTrust_security_intake.xlsx

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Maria Kowalski <maria.kowalski@harbortrust.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-03T08:22:10Z
Subject: Re: Commitment lane: security acceptance & retention action items

Maria — thanks, that's clear and helpful. Short answers up front so we can run the sync on 11/04: 

- Residency: Redwood can support EU-only residency for Hosted if you target our EU region and pick Dedicated capacity in that region. Private (VPC/on-prem) is of course fully resident. We will outline the technical and commercial delta in the call.

- Retention: Hosted default is 5 years for transactional data. We can support 7 years for Hosted under an addendum (pricing impact) or natively for Private. We'll mark this as a decision point in the MAP (action: HarborTrust choose Hosted+7yr vs Private).

- CAIQ turnaround: we can commit to 5 business days from the date of handoff for a completed CAIQ (Rishi to confirm below).

- KMS: for Hosted Dedicated we support customer-managed keys (CMKs) in AWS KMS; for Private we can support your HSM/KMS model (bring-your-own or dedicated HSM). Rishi will outline rotation/escrow options.

Kimberly, Rishi — can you confirm the CAIQ / DocuSign cadence? Maria — I'll send a calendar invite for 11/04 10:00 CET and include a draft DocuSign link for the DPA redline so legal can start pre-review.

Thanks — Jordan

On a process note: we'll add a MAP decision lane that captures the commercial impact of 7-year hosted retention so HarborTrust's procurement folks can see the delta when they review the quote.

Jordan Blake
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Maria Kowalski <maria.kowalski@harbortrust.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-04T10:00:00Z
Subject: Re: Commitment lane: security acceptance & retention action items

Hi Maria / Jordan —

Quick technical confirmation from Security:

- CAIQ: We can complete the CAIQ in 5 business days after we receive HarborTrust_security_intake.xlsx and any clarifying notes. Please flag any items you consider high-priority so we can triage.

- SOC 2 scope: Redwood's current SOC 2 Type II covers the inference stack and control categories CC1–CC7; we will provide the report and a short SOC-to-MAP mapping document on delivery.

- KMS / Key custody:
  * Hosted (multi-tenant / Hosted Dedicated): supports customer-managed AWS KMS CMKs (no Redwood access to CMK). Key escrow is available under a documented process; rotation every 90 days is supported via API.
  * Private (VPC/on‑prem): can support BYOK into your HSM or a dedicated customer HSM.

- Retention options (technical): logs 90 days (ingest-level), backups 1 year by default. Transactional retention can be configured up to 7 years; for Hosted this requires an addendum due to storage tiering and indexing costs. We'll capture estimated monthly delta in the MAP.

- Evidence turnaround: for routine requests (e.g., specific config screenshots, audit logs) we target 30 business days; for CAIQ + SOC2 we will treat as priority items (5 business days CAIQ; SOC 2 delivery per the MAP schedule).

I uploaded the initial DPA redline to DocuSign and shared the link: https://docusign.example.com/HT-DPA-2026-0911 — Kimberly will lead the legal sync.

Happy to go deeper on the call tomorrow.

—Rishi Malhotra
Director, Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com

From: Maria Kowalski <maria.kowalski@harbortrust.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-06T16:45:12Z
Subject: Re: Commitment lane: security acceptance & retention action items

Jordan / Rishi / Kimberly —

Thanks for the detailed answers on the call and follow-up notes. HarborTrust confirms the following so we can mark the MAP as 'Decision-ready':

1) Deployment model: HarborTrust prefers Hosted EU Dedicated but requires 7-year transactional retention. Please add retention delta pricing to the MAP and route to procurement.

2) CAIQ: we'll hand off the completed intake spreadsheet today; please target the 5-business-day CAIQ turnaround you committed to.

3) DPA: we'll review the DocuSign redline this week. If Redwood can make the retention/KEK commitments in the DPA (or via a retention addendum) we should be able to sign by 11/20.

4) Evidence cadence: HarborTrust appreciates the 30-day target for ad‑hoc evidence and the faster path for SOC2/CAIQ. Please include an explicit SLA in the MAP (evidence response: 30 business days, CAIQ: 5 business days).

Action items for Redwood before 11/09 redline meeting:
- Add retention delta (Hosted +7yrs) estimate in the MAP (Jordan / Neha).
- Share completed CAIQ deliverable plan and intake owner (Rishi).
- Kimberly to coordinate DPA negotiation times — proposed meeting 11/09 11:00 CET.

If Redwood can deliver those items, HarborTrust will route to procurement and legal with the intent to finalize by 11/20. Thank you — this is moving faster than expected which is great.

Best regards,
Maria Kowalski
Head of Information Security | HarborTrust
mar ia.kowalski@harbortrust.com
